title: What to Know About the Apple Outage
author: Connor Greene
body:
Apple has resolved outages that impacted several of the company's services on Tuesday, including Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple Support.

Thousands of users had reported experiencing issues with multiple Apple platforms beginning Tuesday morning. Apple attributed the problems to an internal update and said that it was in the process of addressing them as of the afternoon.

"Many of our systems are back up and running after an internal update caused some outages this morning. We’re working to get the remaining systems online as soon as possible,” an Apple spokesperson told TIME at the time. The outages were not a result of a cyber attack, the spokesperson said.

By Tuesday evening, all of the issues appeared to have been resolved.

The disruptions were the latest in a series of outages that have hit major banks, the U.S. air travel system, and the technology company Microsoft and its email platform Outlook in recent days. The outages do not appear to be related.

Here’s what we know about the Apple outages.

Which Apple services were affected?

Apple’s “System Status” page alerted that there was an outage to its AppleCare platform, which provides warranty and technical support for Apple devices, at 11:15 a.m. Eastern Time. Later in the day, at 3:30 p.m,, the company designated the issue as affecting “all users” and “ongoing.” The page also said that “AppleCare purchase is temporarily unavailable.” The AppleCare outage was marked as “Resolved” at 3:39 p.m.

Apple additionally noted an outage impacting its App Store services at 2:27 p.m. “Some users may be experiencing issues with this service,” Apple wrote. The issue, however, was marked as “Resolved” by 3:30 p.m.

By the evening, the "System Status" page listed all of Apple's services as "Available" for all users.

How widespread were the outages?

Reports of outages affecting Apple services began to spike around 11:40 a.m., according to the outage-tracking website Downdetector.com.

By just before 1 p.m., roughly 2,000 users were reporting outages on Apple Support, Apple Pay, and iCloud.
